purpose: Every llama.cpp pin a profile engine launches from {cache_root}/<pin>/src/build/bin/llama-server. Build any pin for any host class with scripts/14_build_llamacpp_pin.sh --pin <id> --host-class <class>. Spark-qualified engines keep the pin their evidence was measured on; moving one is a requalification (AGENTS.md). Off-Spark profiles on upstream llama.cpp use `portable`.

known_issues: #28748 (open): Metal tensor-API mul_mm miscomputes tiles >2 GiB from a tensor start; affects very large tensors (Flash-Next embedding), not Qwen3.8-27B
#30174 (open): Metal draft-mtp allocates up to ~15 GB host memory over a long session (Qwen3.8-27B)
#30175 (open): nondeterministic FA prefill on RDNA3 ROCm with multimodal requests since b10905

llamacpp-qwen38-9d77fa17.rationale: Spark-qualified Qwen3.8-27B pin; builds before b10450 carry the Gated-DeltaNet CUDA corruption bug (scripts/12_build_qwen38_llamacpp.sh)
